results.title: Five new sites, including Udaigiri Caves, added to India’s UNESCO World Heritage tentative list
results.article: On Tuesday, **PIB Culture** announced that five new sites, including the Udaigiri Caves and places linked to Satyagraha in India and South Africa, were added to UNESCO's Tentative List for World Heritage. This brings India’s total to 78 sites. The additions include Bagh Cave Paintings, Group of Temples of Chambal Valley, Ginnorgarh Fort, and the serial transnational proposal on Satyagraha sites. These sites must first be recognized on the tentative list before being considered for World Heritage status.

results.title: Top Court Clamps Down On Misuse Of Child Abuse Law In Matrimonial Disputes
results.article: In a landmark verdict, the **Supreme Court** on Thursday directed that no immediate arrest should be made if false sexual-assault complaints involving children are alleged in matrimonial disputes under the POCSO Act. The court mandated psychological or psychiatric evaluations of children by experts before any arrests can be made, emphasizing the need to protect both the child and accused parent from trauma and public stigma. This decision was passed following a case in Bengaluru where false allegations were made, leading to the restoration of custody to the father.

old.fact_box: The Supreme Court ruled that immediate arrests should be avoided in cases of alleged child sexual assault within matrimonial disputes. The court mandated psychological or psychiatric evaluations of children by experts to prevent trauma and public stigma.

results.title: 'No change in President Trump's position': UK to review Chagos Islands deal with Mauritius - The Times of India
results.article: On Wednesday, **Wes Streeting**, UK defence secretary, announced the UK is reviewing its Chagos Islands deal with Mauritius due to US opposition. This follows President Donald Trump's call for the agreement's termination during a meeting with Prime Minister Andy Burnham at the UN General Assembly in New York City. The original May 2025 deal aimed to transfer sovereignty to Mauritius and lease back Diego Garcia base for £101 million annually, but was paused after Trump reversed his approval in January. Now, the UK seeks joint certainty with US allies for a long-term military presence on Diego Garcia.

results.title: National PNG Drive 3.0 targets 50 lakh new connections and 40 lakh conversions
results.article: Union Petroleum Minister **Hardeep Singh Puri**, the **Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB)**, and city-gas distributors launched National PNG Drive 3.0 on Thursday. Running until FY27, it targets 50 lakh new connections, converting 40 lakh existing ones, and onboarding 50 lakh registrations. The initiative follows a second phase ending June 30, 2026, which added 13.4 lakh billed connections and 15.3 lakh registrations.

results.title: At the NDTV Defence Summit on Sunday, General NS Raja Subramani, Chief
results.article: At the NDTV Defence Summit on Sunday, **General NS Raja Subramani**, Chief of Defence Staff, stated that the situation along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) with China is stable following years of tensions. He noted recent dialogue between President Xi Jinping and Prime Minister Narendra Modi, emphasizing peace through communication. Border Personnel Meetings continue without instability, contrasting Pakistan's threat where India remains vigilant post-Operation Sindoor.
